create_grasp_client: create a GraspClient to send and receive grasp queries from a ROS grasping server
request_grasps: request grasps from the GraspClient by sending segmented point cloud data with camera pose
create_grasp_server: create a GraspServer that listens for grasp requests and processes them with a handler function
parse_point_cloud_msg: parse a ROS PointCloud message into xyz coordinates, rgb values, and segmentation labels
convert_point_cloud_to_msg: convert numpy arrays of xyz, rgb, and labels into a ROS PointCloud message
